data.name: Kahah
data.gender_notes: Kahah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'k-h-h' meaning 'to be strong, powerful'. In the Quran, God Almighty is described as 'Al-Khaliq' (The Creator), emphasizing His strength and power. The name Kahah carries the meaning “Strong, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kahah usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name ‘Kahah’ is said to represent the courage and strength of the Prophet Ibrahim (AS), who was willing to sacrifice his son Ishmael at God’s command.
data.etymology: Kahah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kahah total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
